_meta.definition: The process of creating, updating, and managing web content, including pages, URLs, types, and associated metadata.

columns.name: wp_web_page_sk
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers for web pages.

columns.name: wp_web_page_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the wp_web_page_ entity

columns.name: wp_rec_start_date
columns.description: Stores web page record start dates in YYYY-MM-DD format.

columns.name: wp_rec_end_date
columns.description: Stores end dates of web pages, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD.

columns.name: wp_creation_date_sk
columns.description: Stores sequential integer values representing timestamps of web page creation dates.

columns.name: wp_access_date_sk
columns.description: Stores sequential integer keys representing web page access dates.

columns.name: wp_autogen_flag
columns.description: Web_page autogen_flag indicates whether a page was automatically generated (Y) or manually created (N).

columns.name: wp_customer_sk
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers for customers associated with web pages.

columns.name: wp_url
columns.description: Stores up to 50 characters of web page URLs for the given domain.

columns.name: wp_type
columns.description: Web_page type stores categorization of pages (welcome, protected, feedback, general).

columns.name: wp_char_count
columns.description: Stores the number of characters in web pages.

columns.name: wp_link_count
columns.description: Stores the number of hyperlinks within each web page.

columns.name: wp_image_count
columns.description: Stores the number of images per web page.

columns.name: wp_max_ad_count
columns.description: Stores the maximum number of advertisements allowed per web page.
